parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Input audio or video file. Video inputs have their audio extracted.

parameters.name: modelSize
parameters.description: Whisper model size. Larger is more accurate but slower.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: ISO 639-1 language code (e.g. 'en', 'fr'). Leave empty for auto-detection.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: 'transcribe' keeps the original language, 'translate' targets English.

parameters.name: initialPrompt
parameters.description: Optional text prompt to bias the model's style/vocabulary.

parameters.name: vadFilter
parameters.description: Run silero VAD to skip non-speech regions (recommended).
